minutes.headline: School Committee ratified the custodian union agreement for FY18 to FY22 and reviewed the superintendent's draft goals.
minutes.summary: The committee released executive session minutes and ratified a custodian memorandum of agreement with new stipends and a senior maintenance position. The superintendent presented draft goals for student growth, classroom visits and the new district plan, and members asked for more specific grade levels and a classroom focus. The committee also discussed its own goals, policy subcommittee work, and a projector stabilizer fix.

An added maintenance position approved in the budget was included in the agreement.

The school building committee approved up to a set amount from leftover technology money to fix shaking projectors; the final cost is expected to be less.

Superintendent will send a revised draft of goals after more thought on the classroom focus and grade levels.
Appointment of a school committee rep to the advisory committee will go on the next agenda.
Next meeting set for August 2nd at town hall.

what_happened.line: The School Committee voted to ratify the custodial union agreement covering FY18 to FY22.
The agreement adds stipends for lead, evening-lead and senior custodians, a senior maintenance position, and a slight clothing allowance increase.
The superintendent presented draft goals; members asked for specific grade levels and a classroom focus, and a revised draft will follow.
Formal adoption of the mission, vision and core values is to be an action item next meeting; the full strategic plan may wait until September.
The school building committee approved leftover technology money to fix shaking projectors, with final cost expected to come in lower.

why_it_matters: The custodial agreement sets five years of school staffing costs, including a new maintenance position, which feeds into future school budgets and the town budget, mostly taxes.
The superintendent's goals and the district plan set the measures the committee will use to judge the schools, so their wording shapes what gets reported to families.
watch_next: Next meeting on August 2nd at town hall, with the mission, vision and core values adoption and the advisory committee appointment expected on the agenda.
A revised draft of the superintendent's goals, to be sent after further thought on grade levels and classroom focus.
